## Narrative

UK-based red-team training vendor founded by Daniel Duggan (Rastamouse). Operates RTO (Red Team Operator) and RTO II (Certified Red Team Leader) certifications. [CONFIRMED]

**Why it's well-regarded:** the courseware updates frequently (Cobalt Strike + AD tradecraft rotate as defenders evolve), and the lab is large enough to feel like a real engagement. See @entities/certifications/crto.md.
